KBC LOTTERY PROMOTION 2023
(CERTIFIED PROGRAMME)
CONGRATULATION :
YOU ARE THE BONAFIED WINNER OF (25,00,000 RS/-
SUBJECT : LETTER TO KBC WINNER TO GET LEGAL REGISTERATION.
NAME : [recipient]
LOTTERY AMOUNT: 25,00,000/-
DEAR CUSTUMOR,
YOU ARE ALREADY INFORMED THAT YOU ARE SELECTED AS WINNER OF 25,00,000 RS/-....($ 34,880 US DOLLARS).
NOW TO COLLECT YOUR WINNING AMOUNT YOU HAVE TO REGISTER Y[…]
FROM 'KBC LOTTERY PAYMENT BOARD', SO YOU ARE ADVISED TO […]P IN […]TACT
WITH YOUR CLAIM OFFICER , MR. RANA PRATAP SINGH
AND FOR LEGAL REGISTERATION FOLLOW AS PER DIRECTION .
KBC REGISTRATION CHARG[…]: 6,[…]
A. BACHAN / MUKESH AMBANI
KBC. ADMIN---JIO. CHAIRMAN
notes: KBC lottery / advance-fee prize letter (PIB caption: lottery of Rs 25 lakh on payment of a Rs 6,100 registration fee). The recipient's name is replaced with [recipient]; the small account/file/serial table and the address footer were left out because they are not legible. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
